Name: Ultimate Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]this mod adds a [b]new farm type[/b] to your game with its own farm cave (optional), minecart network, and bonus areas — a quarry, a forest meadow, and a hidden spa! if you have an older save, you can also replace one of the vanilla farms by editing the config file.


[size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/u7OHXN8.png[/img][/b][/size]

[/font][list]
[*]dedicated animal pens with invisible barriers
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]quarry with daily stone and ore spawns[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]forest meadow with berry bushes, renewable hardwood stumps, and forage[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]an extended farm cave plus another small cave at the quarry[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]a secret spa! its entrance is hidden somewhere on the farm[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]a minecart network with shortcuts at each major area of the farm[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]matching world map (vanilla and earthy recolour) and farm icon[/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/14CL8N7.png[/img]
